subject: Scan verified through the real application UI, not only through the parser
why: The first round of OCR work was measured with a Node diagnostic that feeds the raw photograph straight to the parser. The application does not do that: it passes the photograph through the crop editor first. Measuring the real path found two defects the diagnostic could not see, and the reporter correctly observed no improvement in the app.
method: Playwright drives the real interface at 390x844: create course, Allievi, Scan allievi, attach the photograph to the gallery input, confirm the editor, then read the values out of the review inputs.
defectsFoundOnlyInTheRealPath: DEFAULT_STUDENT_SCAN_CROP discarded four percent of every edge before OCR, cutting into the first column and removing the start of the surnames. The cropped photograph lost Veldoro, Dervani and Rumeria entirely.
Fields read below MIN_FIELD_CONFIDENCE were blanked by the parser even though the review screen already marks them 'Da controllare'. The operator was made to retype text the scan had in fact read.
changes: The default crop is the whole frame. A roster photograph is normally framed tightly already, and the operator can still crop.
An uncertain field keeps its text and its confidence, so the review screen flags it instead of hiding it.

Row-level noise and field-level uncertainty are now separate thresholds. MIN_ROW_CONFIDENCE, below the field threshold, still rejects a row with nothing trustworthy in it, which preserves the unusable-photograph behaviour that the blanking used to provide.

beforeThisRound.surnamesPresent: most rows had an empty name field; Veldoro, Dervani and Rumeria were absent

afterThisRound.surnamesPresent: Veldoro, Rumeria, Savagnoli, Lissotti, Feriani, De veltri Gregorio, De veltri Teodoro, Vironè, Pordelli, Travio, Vernuzzi, Dolmari, Naverina, Liosca, Rovellini, Vareni, Cedra, Norali, Esporli

remaining: The name order is still inverted: the roster is surname-first and the surname lands in Nome. The explicit order control exists in the review screen and has not yet been exercised by this harness.
Dervani Roberto falls below the row threshold and is not offered at all.
Some names carry a trailing artefact from the table rule: 'Massimo Ì', 'Nicola I', 'Simone gi', and two rows begin with a stray 's' or '-'.
No row is complete enough to count as ready, so the operator still confirms every row.
runtime: Node 24.21.0, 374 unit and component tests, production build and PWA check all pass.
